zh.title: 发布状态
items: **0.1.0-rc.18** 修复 DeepSeek 工具调用后的继续执行、历史任务重复续接，以及回复已交付后仍反复唤醒的问题。正式版仍为 0.0.18，本版用于继续评测。

zh.title: 修复
items: DeepSeek 思考模式保留服务实际返回的推理字段，工具结果返回后可以继续执行；旧模型历史不再伪装成新的工具调用，不补造思考内容或重放已完成操作。
恢复任务时保留原生调用历史，同时使用当前系统上下文，让最新用户输入、任务结果与交付规则进入本次续跑。
同一对话中、同一子任务的重复后台续接合并为一个负责人；新用户输入优先处理，取消、未知执行结果及权限边界继续保留。
已正式交付且事实未变化的结果进入持久化静默等待；实际任务状态、复核结果或用户问题变化后才重新处理。交付依据仍由本地宿主核对。
修复长协调日志在正常追加读取前重复扫描全文的问题，保留损坏尾部恢复与严格校验。

zh.title: 升级与验证范围
items: 升级前备份完整数据根，Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway 同步升级。本版新增协调日志事件，旧版可能拒绝恢复新日志；回退须恢复完整升级前备份。
源码真实任务覆盖 DeepSeek 派工、读写与命令执行、独立上下文复核、正式回复、取消、重启恢复，以及重复历史续接收束。GPT 主 Bot 与 DeepSeek 子任务的首轮复核出现服务输出格式错误；同一任务显式续接后完成，未重做文件修改。
产品截图为实施者自审，非独立审查。小型隔离任务不代表任意项目、网络或长期日用；Windows/Linux 交互安装、完整读屏与安装器交接另行覆盖。
同步双语发布说明、README 版本入口和文档站更新日志。

en.title: Release status
items: **0.1.0-rc.18** fixes DeepSeek continuation after tool calls, duplicate historical continuations and repeated wakes after a result has already been delivered. Stable remains 0.0.18; this prerelease is for continued evaluation.

en.title: Fixes
items: Preserve authentic reasoning fields returned by DeepSeek in thinking mode so execution can continue after tool results. Historical calls from older models become labelled history instead of new executable calls; reasoning is never fabricated and completed operations are not replayed.
Restore native call history with the current assembled system context so new user input, task results and delivery rules reach the resumed turn.

Coalesce duplicate background continuations for the same child task and parent conversation under one owner. Prioritize new user input while preserving cancellation, unknown outcomes and permission boundaries.

Persist quiet waiting after verified delivery when the underlying facts are unchanged. Resume processing when task state, verification observations or user questions change, with delivery evidence still checked locally.
Avoid rescanning a complete coordination journal before normal appended reads while retaining damaged-tail recovery and strict validation.

en.title: Upgrade and validation scope
items: Back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together. This release adds coordination journal events that older versions may refuse to restore. Rollback requires the complete pre-upgrade backup.

Source real-model acceptance covers DeepSeek delegation, file and command tools, verification in an independent context, formal delivery, cancellation, restart recovery and duplicate historical continuation settlement. A GPT main Bot with DeepSeek workers initially encountered malformed verifier output; explicit continuation completed the same task without repeating file edits.

Screenshot review is implementer self-review, not independent review. Small isolated tasks do not cover arbitrary projects, networks or long-term use. Interactive Windows/Linux installation, full screen-reader coverage and installer handoff remain separate.
Synchronize bilingual release notes, README version links and the documentation-site changelog.
